Rosa Damascena.

Damask or Damascus Rose.─N. O. Rosaceæ. Tincture of the flowers (?).

Clinical.─Hay-fever.

Characteristics.─Farrington mentions that R. dam. was introduced by Jeanes as a remedy at the beginning of rose-cold when the Eustachian tube is involved, with some degree of deafness and tinnitus.
